## Review and repair

- Reviewers/agents used and latest reviewed commit:
- Review rounds / repair passes:
- Findings fixed (links to threads/commits):

## Merge readiness

- [ ] Source/target follows `feature/* -> develop` or `develop -> main`.
- [ ] Required Linux/Windows checks passed on the latest head.
- [ ] Actionable P0/P1 findings are fixed; P2 findings are fixed or explicitly dispositioned.
- [ ] Relevant review conversations are resolved with evidence.
- [ ] Manual functional acceptance and release-specific gates are complete (if applicable).

See [PR review and repair workflow](https://github.com/Treca-Raja/rajcord-public/blob/develop/docs/pr-review-workflow.md).
